passages.text: If you already subscribed to Ruben Hassid (my Substack), you will eventually master all of the above. But let’s focus today on my free “**Prompt Maker**”.
I prompted: “A prompt to write drastically different hooks for a Linkedin post I share.” Here’s my Prompt Maker’s answer:
When copying & pasting, be careful with the green text: it says “Insert Linkedin post here” so it’s up to you to insert it the right way. To do so, I write this:
2. Paste it on a new ChatGPT chat → paste your own Linkedin post → choose the model o3 (at the top left).
I input: “A prompt to read my last 3 newsletters I input to search the web & give me ideas for new topics.”
